messages:
Lena: Morning 12 Pearl attempted a dramatic sideways hop on the balcony and then immediately claimed the top of the ficus as her throne. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/pearl/3165001234_pearl_throne.jpg
Arjun: 102 majestic. full pigeon energy.
Maya: 10/10 posture. is that a tiny sandbag or theatrical fluff?
Lena: its fluff. also she nailed a sideways hop today 12 video is mostly me laughing but ill drop it.
Sam: training for the Pigeon Olympics: synchronized preen and 3m hop champion 973
Chris: we should get her a tiny cape. :cape: for dramatic feathers
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "pearl_sidehop.mov" 12 https://cdn.redwood.app/pearl/3165001234_sidehop.mov
Maya: embedding that here so folks dont miss it: <https://cdn.redwood.app/pearl/3165001234_sidehop.mov|pearl_sidehop.mov>
Arjun: watched it. 0.8/1 technical execution, 12/10 charisma. tried to imitate at my desk, failed.
Lena: bonus: she roosted on my keyboard for 3 minutes and sent an accidental email. if you got a subject line like "coo!" 12 that was her. :grimacing:
Sam: that is the kind of low-severity incident i want in the quarterly morale highlights.
Chris: quick poll: make Pearl an honorary mascot? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Arjun: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
